scope: Local collection browsing, visible posting feedback and current-search/page binding. No new live-model or independent quality results.

initial_targeted.failure: Selecting a second posting left the previous description rendered in its earlier row. Successful queuing now clears old detail/error state before listing rendering.

late_verified_guard_followup: Eight posting-action cases pass after strengthening their returned controlled payloads to verified content.
review_grades: All 408 remain blank; no independent quality result.
ci_status: All 1,612 tests and nine runtime checks pass on Linux and Windows; all 25 browser gates pass.

local_deployment.scope: Local/offline runtime readiness only; external sources and provider credentials are not verified.

checks.name: configuration
checks.detail: Runtime values validated; credentials excluded.

checks.name: shared_mode
checks.detail: Shared hosting requires ECE_DEVELOPMENT_MODE=false.

checks.name: server_configuration
checks.detail: Listen address, port, and URL prefix validated; no socket opened.

checks.name: dependencies
checks.detail: Installed versions compared with production requirements.

checks.name: catalog
checks.detail: Expanded runtime catalog and frozen baseline validated.

checks.name: connectors
checks.detail: Connector configuration validated without network requests.

checks.name: cache
checks.detail: Source and embedding cache directories are writable.

checks.name: liveness
checks.detail: Loopback Streamlit health endpoint.

checks.name: offline_preview
checks.detail: Credential-free preview roadmap; HTTP clients blocked.

checks.name: initial_roadmap
checks.detail: Production UI renders and submits a preview roadmap; AI remains off.

checks.name: request_progress
checks.detail: The completed request retains visible stage feedback without claiming AI generation.

checks.name: lazy_inspector
checks.detail: Closed inspector sends no charts; opening and closing complete fragment runs without rerunning the app.

checks.name: current_course_filtering
checks.detail: Current ECE101 is visible as coursework and absent from next-step cards.

checks.name: completion_transition
checks.detail: Completion moves ECE101 out of current study and retains its unknown grade.

checks.name: profile_export
checks.detail: The UI downloads a valid controlled profile including manual current coursework.

checks.name: profile_restore
checks.detail: An uploaded UI export restores the edited profile exactly, including all saved fields.

checks.name: session_isolation
checks.detail: Two isolated browser contexts retain different profiles while both sessions remain open.

checks.name: unsupported_request
checks.detail: An unsupported question requests clarification, without course cards or cross-session changes.

checks.name: websocket_sessions
checks.detail: Both real Streamlit WebSockets exchange frames with no stream closure or page JavaScript errors.

limits: Preview mode only; no AI, relevance, or participant evaluation.

checks.name: blank_review
checks.detail: All 408 ratings start blank, with no chosen grade or reviewer role.

checks.name: explicit_grades
checks.detail: Blank saves do not grade; explicit zero and three save separate evidence judgments.

checks.name: draft_download
checks.detail: A real download retains two explicit fixture ratings, notes schema, and draft provenance.

checks.name: incomplete_completion_blocked
checks.detail: An incomplete draft cannot be exported as a completed review.

checks.name: resume_and_isolation
checks.detail: A separate session starts blank and restores the downloaded draft exactly.

checks.name: wrong_packet_rejected
checks.detail: A foreign packet hash is rejected without replacing saved ratings or producing page errors.

limits: Only controlled fixture actions; no independent judgments or quality score.
No supplied-host, participant, or public hosting validation.

checks.name: source_plan_before_ai
checks.detail: A usable source plan appears while the controlled provider is still blocked.

checks.name: draft_retention
checks.detail: The form remains editable and retains its unsubmitted draft when AI completes.

checks.name: newer_profile_wins
checks.detail: A newer profile completes while the old provider waits; releasing the old response cannot replace it.

checks.name: keep_source_plan
checks.detail: Keeping the source plan stops result acceptance, retains the plan and rejects late AI output.

checks.name: collection_filters
checks.detail: Course-code, type and direction filters update locally; opening details keeps source metadata and triggers no advisor run.

checks.name: mobile_collection
checks.detail: Filters and reset work at a 390-pixel phone width without horizontal page overflow or a full-app request.

checks.name: posting_progress
checks.detail: A deliberately delayed detail request shows feedback beside the selected listing and does not rerun the roadmap.

checks.name: posting_failure_retains_search
checks.detail: A failed recheck clears verified content while retaining the saved search; neither search nor AI is repeated.

checks.name: browser_health
checks.detail: The real Streamlit session exchanges full and fragment updates with no JavaScript errors.

limits: Provider outputs and delays are controlled fixtures; no live AI quality or latency is measured.
Sources are dated bundled snapshots; the helper blocks all server-side HTTP calls.
This checks one local browser session, not public hosting or participant usability.
